summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible work within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing evidence and containment work. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; all four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open; accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, and attribution gates remain incomplete; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Revenue is limited to 2026-09-21: $4.92 aggregate commission remains unattributed. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Partial progress consists of official Woot-source evidence, repository/configuration artifacts, and privacy/cookie-policy artifacts; none supports closure. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures. Close no task without attached evidence and satisfied non-legal gates.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data—counsel_required. Missing evidence: written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics—evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Site decisions: retain complicated.work parked because it is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks; rerun the same checks after isolated remediation. Retain deadlymaracas.com parked because DNS fetch failed and compliance, reachability, analytics, monetization, and launch evidence are unknown; require a dated reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision checklist before any launch step. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth, but failed or unknown compliance gates remain site-specific blockers.
